words.gloss: to go through; to come in

lines.trans: Judging by your luxury suite, things are going well for you!
The company pays for the room, I work as a department head.
Cool, and how is your personal life? Are you married?
No, I still have not met anyone.
I probably just cannot forget my first love.
Come on, admirers are surely standing in a long line!
Let's not talk about sad things, let's kiss instead?
Dasha, no, I recently went through a painful breakup.
I see, then you simply need to clear your head a bit!
Tomorrow I am flying to Sochi on our bank's plane.
That is unlikely to work out, I have urgent work downstairs.
Come in, Max, tell me, how is your life going?
